headline: Junior Backend Developer
summary: Detail-oriented Junior Backend Developer and recent BSc (Hons) Computing graduate from Islington College. Proven ability to develop robust server-side logic and manage databases through a comprehensive internship at F1Soft International and a complex academic capstone project. Skilled in Java, Spring Boot, and Node.js with a strong foundation in microservices and RESTful API design.
